PM Modi Highlights Semiconductor Mission at SEMICON India 2026

Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed SEMICON India 2026, highlighting the nation's semiconductor mission and announcing the approval of 12 chip projects. He stated that India has achieved in four years what typically takes a decade, emphasizing the progress in the semiconductor sector. The mission involves an investment of $13.5 billion.
